'''Brian William Manley''' (30 June 1929 – 20 December 2014) was a British physicist and engineer. He served as president of the [[Institution of Electrical Engineers]] in 1991 and was president of the [[Institute of Physics]] from 1996-1998.<ref>University of Sussex awards honorary degrees http://www.sussex.ac.uk/newsandevents/pressrelease/media/media235.html</ref>
